instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry all of the mushrooms.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg white mushrooms
0.68 kg cremini mushrooms
3 caps portobello mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Remove the stems of the portobello mushrooms; scrape out the gills using a spoon. Dice into 1-inch cubes.
Slice remaining mushrooms and set them aside with the portobello mushrooms.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Trim, peel, and finely dice the shallot. Add to the pot, stirring regularly and cook until the shallots soften, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 shallots

instructions.primary_message: Once shallots are soft add mushrooms to pot and continue to stir.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the pot.
Season mushroom mixture with thyme, rosemary, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are tender and shallots are translucent, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp thyme
1 ½ tsp rosemary
1 tbsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to pot. Add broth and bring mixture to a boil.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cups basmati rice
1065 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Lower heat to medium-low. Cover with a tight-fitting lid and cook without disturbing for 15-20 minutes.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
When rice is cooked, stir in butter and Parmesan cheese until melted. Top with prepared parsley. Serve warm, enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
170 g Parmesan cheese
⅓ cup butter, unsalted
